# Sky Studio (Minecraft 26.3, Fabric, client-side)

Client-only sky control: time of day, sun/sky colours, stars, galaxies, shooting stars, clouds, solar system.
Press the key bound in Options > Controls > "Sky Studio" (default K) to open the settings screen.

## Build on GitHub
1. Push this folder to a GitHub repo (branch `main`).
2. Open the **Actions** tab, the "Build Sky Studio" workflow runs automatically.
3. When it's green, open the run and download the **skystudio-jar** artifact.
4. Put the jar in your `mods` folder with Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API for 26.3.

If the build fails, open the failed run, copy the red compiler errors and send them back.
